initial_answers.reason: The handoff supplies no corrected historic completion counts for either depot. The index identifies relevant records but is not measurement evidence; later enrollment policy cannot establish the historic comparisons.

Permission to display exhibition excerpts does not establish transcription accuracy or authorization to release the complete automated catalog. The handoff does not specify the complete-catalog release conditions.
The handoff proposes a dawn-shift study but provides no subgroup results establishing a bicycle delivery effect. Missing results do not establish a zero effect.
